newsitem.title: LATVIA: KAIJA PROSPECTUS IN BOURSE AFTER APRIL 20.
newsitem.headline: KAIJA PROSPECTUS IN BOURSE AFTER APRIL 20.

text.p: Kaija fish cannery's prospectus on joining the bourse's official list will be submitted to the Riga stock exchange after April 20, a spokesman for food group Ave La, which owns kaija, said on Friday.
"The prospectus will be in the bourse after April 20 as Kaija wants to add the audited 1996 figures," the spokesman told Reuters.
"The prospectus has been in preparation since last autumn," the spokesman said, adding that it needs updating.

"I thinhk that the bourse will review the document very quickly," he said. "Kaija representaives have alredy had meetings with the exchange's management and there is sufficient knowledge about Kaija in the bourse."
kaija is currently quoted on the secondary list of the market and is a fairly active share.
